items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: We both studied with Nadia Boulanger back in 1956.

ctx.x: I see you’ve worked on “Sesame Street?”

Yeah. I never did it as a steady job but they have a character there called Telly monster. And he plays — they call it a tuba, it turns out to be like an E flat alto horn that’s all smashed up and he kind of holds it while a tuba player plays the tuba. And I was the tuba player on many occasions. So a lot of the episodes where Telly monster has some sort of carryings on about playing tuba or dropping it or losing it or whatever, the tuba that you hear is me. Joe Raposo and I were friends for years. We both…
